640:t_1:4.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「...That month went by in a flash.」

640:t_1:6.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「You're leaving for the galactic center tomorrow, then.」

640:t_1:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Battles against $$サイデリアル$$'s main force... and $$バアル$$ await us there.」

640:t_1:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「But we won't have real peace until we've settled things with them.」

640:t_1:9.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「If we leave them alone, $$サイデリアル$$ will surely invade Earth again.」

640:t_1:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「What's more, they say the $$バアル$$ outbreak at the galactic center is on a whole different scale from when we were transported there before.」

640:t_1:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「There's no doubt now that this is a sign of the universe's great collapse, which happens once every 120 million years.」

640:t_1:12.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Reaching an understanding with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and learning what's happening in the galaxy was a major breakthrough.」

640:t_1:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「Their homeworld was destroyed by $$バアル$$, too... So they say they'll help us defeat them.」

640:t_1:14.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「I hope you can coordinate with the $$人類銀河同盟$$ and the other organizations, too...」

640:t_1:15.en:
$$シモン$$
「We'll give it a try at the center of the galaxy.」

640:t_1:16.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「We were able to connect with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and $$バジュラ$$. I'm sure it's possible.」

640:t_1:17.en:
$$シモン$$
「The galaxy's central point is believed to be $$バアル$$'s nest... If we win the battle there, we should be able to stop the collapse that happens every 120 million years.」

640:t_1:18.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ロシウ$$... I'm counting on you to look after Earth while we're gone.」

640:t_1:19.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「As a precaution, the residents of the colonies, $$翠の地球$$, and $$火星$$ are evacuating to $$蒼の地球$$.」

640:t_1:20.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Humanity intends to commit all its remaining forces to defending $$蒼の地球$$.」

640:t_1:21.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$新世界大陸$$ is taking in people from $$プラント$$ and the $$残されの海$$, right?」

640:t_1:22.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Beastmen and humans coexist here, after all. We have the foundation to welcome anyone.」

640:t_1:23.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Though the people from the $$残されの海$$ do seem rather bewildered by their first experience of life on land.」

640:t_1:24.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$レド$$ and $$エイミー$$ got used to life with $c. I'm sure they can, too.」

640:t_1:25.en:
$$ニア$$
「It looks like you've finished saying goodbye to $$ロシウ$$, $$シモン$$.」

640:t_1:26.en:
$$シモン$$
「...I'll ask you one last time, $$ニア$$. You're really coming with $c, right?」

640:t_1:27.en:
$$ニア$$
「...While we were trapped in another dimension aboard $$超銀河ダイグレン$$, I kept thinking about it.」

640:t_1:28.en:
$$ニア$$
「What would I do if I never saw you again, $$シモン$$...?」

640:t_1:30.en:
$$ニア$$
「Neither the world nor I can be sure of seeing tomorrow. So I've decided never to leave your side again, $$シモン$$.」

640:t_1:31.en:
$$シモン$$
「All right. I don't want to let you go, either, $$ニア$$.」

640:t_1:32.en:
$$シモン$$
「Once it's all over and Earth is at peace...」

640:t_1:34.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's have our wedding then. We'll invite all our dear friends.」

640:t_1:35.en:
$$ニア$$
「Hearing that makes me feel that we absolutely must come home.」

640:t_1:36.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Then please let me serve as your witness when that day comes.」

640:t_1:39.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「...You can win, can't you, $$シモン$$?」

640:t_1:40.en:
$$シモン$$
「Who the hell do you think I am?」

640:t_1:41.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「You're $$シモン$$. Wherever you go, whoever you face.」

640:t_1:42.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah...! I'll come back, and I'll bring victory with me.」

640:t_1:46.en: ～$$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Interior Facilities～

640:t_1:47.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...So you and the others spent this whole month running a space odd-job service, $$ワッ太$$...」

640:t_1:48.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We had to get ready for our trip into the galaxy, too, so I really wanted to take it easy.」

640:t_1:49.en:
$$勝平$$
「What are you talking about, President? Compared to when you were whining about having no work, this is a pretty good problem to have!」

640:t_1:50.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$蒼の地球$$ was busy everywhere, rebuilding and taking in refugees.」

640:t_1:51.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So every super robot was called in to help.」

640:t_1:52.en:
$$葵$$
「I never imagined I'd do construction work with $$ダンクーガ$$.」

640:t_1:53.en:
$$赤木$$
「Quit griping, $$葵$$. I had a lot more fun doing that work than fighting.」

640:t_1:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「But thanks to everyone's hard work, we finished much earlier than planned. Director $$大塚$$ was delighted, too.」

640:t_1:55.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Now we can cut loose out in the galaxy without anything weighing on us!」

640:t_1:56.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But when we speak of this month's rapid changes, we mustn't forget the reconciliation between Earth and space.」

640:t_1:57.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Revealing $$クロノ$$'s existence and its doctrine must have changed people's outlook.」

640:t_1:58.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Besides, it'd be embarrassing for fellow humans to keep fighting when we've even made friends with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

640:t_1:59.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Queen $$ディアナ$$, Princess $$ミネバ$$, Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$ and the others did a lot to bridge Earth and space, too.」

640:t_1:60.en:
$$リディ$$
「Are you sure, $$バナージ$$? You aren't going to see $$ミネバ$$ before we leave tomorrow?」

640:t_1:61.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's all right. We talked a lot the other day.」

640:t_1:62.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I'll come back to you, no matter what... I'll keep that promise, $$オードリー$$...)

640:t_1:63.en:
$$刹那$$
「Are you sure, too, $$ヒイロ$$? It seems you haven't seen Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$.」

640:t_1:64.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I don't have any particular reason to.」

640:t_1:65.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「All I have to do is win peace.」

640:t_1:67.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If we've reached the stage called the civilization of fire, we have a duty to carry it forward into the future.」

640:t_1:68.en:
$$シャア$$
「For that reason, too... we can't let this world end.」

640:t_1:69.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The power to do that... a fleet bringing together all of humanity's strength, sets sail tomorrow.」

640:t_1:70.en:
$$キラ$$
「The universe's great collapse once every 120 million years... The huge $$バアル$$ outbreak that heralds it...」

640:t_1:71.en:
$$シン$$
「In other words, if we defeat $$バアル$$, the great collapse won't happen, right?」

640:t_1:72.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「That's the conclusion we reach from interpreting the records left in various ruins, including those of the $$プロトカルチャー$$.」

640:t_1:73.en:
$$レド$$
「And now that the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ have revealed that the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest is at the galaxy's central point...」

640:t_1:74.en:
$$レド$$
「We'll challenge them to a decisive battle there, with humanity's... the whole galaxy's fate at stake.」

640:t_1:75.en:
$$桂$$
「Still, I know what we're up against, but I can't believe they built something like that in just a month.」

640:t_1:76.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Originally, it was part of an Earth defense plan underway since the $$時獄戦役$$...」

640:t_1:77.en:
$$オルソン$$
「And apparently its design was based on data found inside $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$.」

640:t_1:78.en:
$$シャア$$
「Its structure and systems are unique, and they've succeeded in making it smaller than the original.」

640:t_1:79.en:
$$アスラン$$
「It's smaller, even at that size...!?」

640:t_1:80.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「I feel faint just thinking about how huge the real one must have been...」

640:t_1:81.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I hear the research data $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ left behind also contributed greatly to its development.」

640:t_1:82.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What's more, he apparently had data from ruins at the edge of the solar system that $$サイデリアル$$ controlled.」

640:t_1:84.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Do you mean that mysterious dimensional distortion everyone in the $$クラッシャー隊$$ was investigating?」

640:t_1:85.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's right. We haven't heard the details either, but apparently an ancient civilization's fleet had been left intact there.」
